run_flask_server: run a Flask server hosting a Parlai model via the parlai flask CLI command
serve_model_with_flask: serve a Parlai model like repeat_query or blender_90M through a Flask API endpoint
create_chatbot_response_endpoint: create a Flask route at /response that accepts POST JSON with a text field and returns the model response
test_flask_chatbot_api: test the Flask chatbot API by sending a curl POST request with JSON text to localhost:5000/response
review_flask_class: review the Flask class that extends ParlaiScript to host a chatbot model as a web service
